scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w packages/server" "npm run dev -w packages/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/server && npm run test -w packages/client && npm run test -w packages/tools
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client && tsc --noEmit -p packages/tools
